summary: Documents the three-tier branch model (epic/release/main), epic-close ceremony, and release ceremony across all agent-facing doc surfaces.
migration_impact: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and copilot-instructions.md now document the epic/release/main branch model, fragment-first authoring, and both ceremonies. Downstream repos should sync these sections when upgrading.
migration_guidance: 1. Add a 'Branch Model and Ceremonies' section to AGENTS.md following the pattern in akasper/plate AGENTS.md §Branch Model and Ceremonies.
2. Update CONTRIBUTING.md §Branch and Pull Request Rules to describe the three-tier model and reference the ceremonies.
3. Update copilot-instructions.md to reference 'gh plate release status', 'gh plate release notes', and fragment-first authoring.
4. Add 'Release' to the issue type label enumeration in all three docs.
5. Update Documentation Rules to say 'author a fragment under .agentic/releases/unreleased/<slug>.json' rather than 'update a change file'.
agent_notes: When working in a PLATE repo, always check AGENTS.md §Branch Model and Ceremonies to understand which branch to target for a Feature PR (the Epic branch, not main). Use gh plate release status before opening a Release PR.
